_note: Verified 2026-08-18 by direct page fetch. residency_km is the hard gate for paid-on-call roles - it disqualifies more candidates than certification does. Distances are from Onoway / Lac Ste. Anne County.

employers.name: Unlimited Safety Services Ltd.
employers.city: Onoway (HQ) - work at Alberta Beach and various
employers.residency_rule: None - they are headquartered in her own town
employers.notes: *** MOST URGENT LEAD FOUND. EXPIRES AUG 20. *** Industrial Firefighter / Emergency Medical Responder. $900-$3,000 per week, full-time AND casual. Headquartered in ONOWAY - Sandra s own town - with work at Alberta Beach, which is minutes away. The posting states NO NFPA 1001 requirement anywhere; it asks for EMR, physical capability and professionalism. That is exactly the gap-friendly profile. Applications route through Talent.com and no direct email is exposed, so this needs a PHONE CALL or a WALK-IN - trivial when they are local. Second near-duplicate posting at jobbank.gc.ca/jobsearch/jobposting/50075157.

employers.name: Parkland County
employers.residency_rule: Not published as a fixed radius
employers.notes: TOP TARGET. Wabamun and Tomahawk stations border Lac Ste. Anne County. NFPA 1001 Level 1 provided through the program, not required to apply. Needs: HS diploma, Standard First Aid + CPR, Class 5 (<6 demerits), medical clearance form, CRC + vulnerable sector, 18+. Deputy Chief Aaron Davies already knows us from the NFPA training thread.

employers.name: Town of Mayerthorpe
employers.notes: LIVE NOW: page reads 'Mayerthorpe Fire Department - NOW RECRUITING'. Inside Lac Ste. Anne County, roughly 40 km from Onoway. Open practice Thursdays 7pm at 4814-42 Ave, and walking in is a genuine application route here. Chief Randy Schroeder 780-608-3392, firechief@mayerthorpe.ca - he also holds an lsac.ca address, so he already works alongside Sandra's county.

employers.name: Sturgeon County
employers.residency_rule: Must live within 10 km of a covered station
employers.stations: Bon Accord, Calahoo, Legal, Namao, Redwater
employers.notes: OPEN NOW, closes Aug 30. $23.30/hr start plus holiday pay, WCB, life insurance. NFPA 1001 Level I taught in-house Jan-June, weekly evenings. 10 km residency rule is the gate - Calahoo is the nearest station to Onoway; verify the distance before applying. Contact protectsvcs@sturgeoncounty.ca / 780-939-8400.

employers.name: Town of Westlock
employers.notes: LIVE NOW: currently accepting applications for Volunteer Firefighter. Route is a downloadable information package plus direct contact with the chief, so a warm email beats any portal. Chief Stuart Koflick, skoflick@westlock.ca, 780-350-2114.

employers.name: Lac Ste. Anne County
employers.notes: Sandra's OWN county, and it runs a composite model - full-time, part-time AND paid-on-call across 7 stations (Sangudo, Onoway, Rich Valley, Darwell, Mayerthorpe, Cherhill). Recruitment runs as a standing Expression of Interest form rather than dated postings, which means an internal move to a paid or full-time seat is an ask she can make at any time, from the inside, with a service record already on file.

employers.name: Town of Stony Plain
employers.window_opens: soon - annual casual intake, date unpublished
employers.notes: Runs its own department, independent of Parkland County. 44 casual + 6 full-time. No prior experience required; 240-260 hrs paid first-year training. Page currently says intake opening soon - worth a direct call to 780-963-3551.

employers.name: Lamont County (Bruderheim, Lamont, Chipman, Andrew, Mundare)
employers.notes: Appears to accept applications year-round - no deadline found, unlike its neighbours. No pre-service training required; all training provided after hire. Also runs a Junior Firefighter program (16-18). Contact lces.admin@lamontcounty.ca. Distance from Onoway is the drawback.

employers.name: Thorhild County
employers.notes: LIVE NOW: Paid-On-Call Firefighter sits among current openings, continuous intake. NFPA 1001 training is provided by the department. Needs 18+ and a SureHire onboarding physical. Prior experience is called an asset rather than a requirement, so Sandra is well above their entry bar. Chief Denis Poulin, denis.poulin@thorhildcounty.com, 780-398-3741 x2804.

employers.name: Leduc County
employers.residency_rule: Must live or work within 19 km of a station
employers.stations: Calmar, New Sarepta, Nisku, Thorsby, Warburg
employers.notes: NFPA provided post-hire, and prior credentials can earn challenge-exam credit - relevant to Sandra's partial 1001. 19 km rule is generous but Warburg is still a stretch from Onoway. Also covers Calmar and Thorsby, which contract their fire service to the county.

employers.name: Westlock County
employers.notes: Standing recruitment across five halls, around 75 paid-on-call members. Requirements are modest: Class 5 plus abstract, RCMP vulnerable sector check, physically fit, 75 percent practice attendance. Faye Doblanko 780-307-0579, info@westlockcounty.com.

employers.name: Alberta Wildfire
employers.notes: Seasonal wildland crews. Hiring opens over winter for a spring start, so this is a January-ish calendar item. No NFPA 1001 requirement; S-100 is the relevant ticket. A genuine route to paid fire work that does not care about municipal residency rules.

employers.name: Town of Devon
employers.residency_rule: Must live within 8 minutes of Devon station
employers.notes: Accepts applications year-round. 12-week / 96-hour recruit program after hire. The 8-minute response rule almost certainly rules Onoway out, but worth logging. Contact JHay@devon.ca.

employers.name: Woodlands County
employers.notes: Rolling intake at Blue Ridge, Anselmo and Goose Lake stations; Fort Assiniboine is closed to new members. Paid per incident plus mileage, with WCB and insurance covered. No prior experience required. fireservices@woodlands.ab.ca.

employers.name: Falck Safety Services Canada
employers.notes: Contract industrial fire and rescue. A well-known entry route into paid fire work for candidates without full municipal certification, often rotational.

employers.name: Town of Gibbons
employers.notes: Independent department - explicitly NOT part of the Sturgeon County regional arrangement. Annual hiring commences every August, so it may be live right now. No requirements published; check their Facebook page or call 780-923-3331.

employers.name: Town of Edson
employers.notes: LIVE: their page says they are looking for new members now. 36 volunteer members plus a full-time chief. They ask for a driver abstract and criminal record check, with a yearly fitness evaluation. Chief Joey Cherpin, joeyc@edson.ca or edsonfire@edson.ca, 780-723-3178.

employers.name: Town of Morinville
employers.residency_rule: Must reside within Morinville town limits
employers.notes: Reopens Aug 31; physical test first week of November, interviews second week. Residency inside town limits is a hard gate - likely disqualifying unless relocating. Contact fire.rescue@morinville.ca.

employers.name: City of Edmonton
employers.notes: CALENDAR ITEM: applications accepted ONLY Jan 1-31, for the following year's recruit class. NFPA 1001 not required - trained in-house. DOES require one of Advanced First Aid (80hr) / EMR / PCP / ACP at application, and Class 3 with air brakes by hire. The medical cert is the thing to line up between now and January. Contact firefighterrecruitment@edmonton.ca.

employers.name: Town of Whitecourt
employers.notes: Up to 42 paid-on-call plus full-time officers. No window open now; they announce recruitment through their website and social media, so this one needs watching rather than applying. firedepartment@whitecourt.ca, 780-778-2342.

employers.name: Edmonton International Airport (YEG)
employers.notes: ARFF - aircraft rescue and firefighting. Full-time, no municipal residency rule, commutable from Onoway. Worth watching.

employers.name: Strathcona County
employers.residency_rule: Part-time: within 12-minute drive of Station 2 or 3
employers.notes: Part-time/on-call stream closed Dec 2025, next cycle unannounced - worth watching. Full-time requires ACP/PCP paramedic registration. NFPA 1001 I+II preferred, not mandatory. Contact joinSCES@strathcona.ca.

employers.name: Town of Hinton
employers.notes: 34 paid-on-call plus 3 full-time. Continuous intake - they invite a resume and cover letter dropped at the hall or emailed, with no formal posting. firehall@hinton.ca, 780-865-6009.

employers.name: Yellowhead County
employers.notes: Composite service: full-time, casual and paid-on-call. Annual window has closed (was May 31), so calendar this for spring. Their board carries standing categories for Casual Firefighter (Evansburg) and Firefighter (East Operations). Note the real domain is yhcounty.ca - yellowheadcounty.ab.ca is dead.

employers.notes: No competitions running. Full-time requires ACP/PCP paramedic OR heavy-equipment/automotive journeyperson - a high bar. NFPA 1001 I+II obtainable within 1 year of hire. Trevor Sutherley there already responded helpfully on the live-fire question.

employers.name: Smoky Lake County (regional)
employers.notes: Regional service shared with Smoky Lake, Vilna and Waskatenau. A firefighter recruitment PDF exists on their site but could not be read, so this one is worth a direct call. Chief Scott Franchuk, sfranchuk@smokylakecounty.ab.ca, 780-656-3730 x117.

employers.name: Suncor Energy

employers.name: Town of Athabasca
